title: L. Ron Hubbard Writers of the Future Contest
description: A long-running quarterly short fiction contest for new and amateur science fiction, fantasy, and dark fantasy writers, run by Author Services Inc. Entrants submit an original, unpublished short story (under 10,000 words) or novelette (under 17,000 words) in English; entry is completely free, with no reading or processing fee at any stage. Eligibility is limited to writers who have not professionally published a novel or short novel, more than one novelette, or more than three short stories (professional publication defined as at least 8 cents/word and at least 5,000 copies or hits) -- work generated by AI is disqualified. Each quarter has three cash prizes (1st: $1,000, 2nd: $750, 3rd: $500); quarterly winners are flown to Hollywood, California, put up at a hotel, and given much of their meals, to attend a free week-long professional writing workshop taught by bestselling authors, followed by the black-tie L. Ron Hubbard Writers & Illustrators of the Future Annual Awards Ceremony, where one of the year's quarterly winners is also named Grand Prize winner and receives an additional $5,000. The Contest year runs in four quarters (Oct 1-Dec 31, Jan 1-Mar 31, Apr 1-Jun 30, Jul 1-Sep 30); this entry covers the current quarter, closing September 30, 2026. Open to writers worldwide with no nationality restriction.
org: Author Services, Inc. (L. Ron Hubbard Writers & Illustrators of the Future Contest)
visaNote: Winners travel to the US for a short workshop/awards trip, not employment; non-US winners should confirm short-stay visa/ESTA requirements ahead of the trip.
